description: The avatar window (built at runtime by overlay_windows.rs): its status events, and moving and resizing itself while in Arrange. App commands (avatar_handshake, avatar_beat, set_avatar_mode, avatar_vrm, avatar_loaded, get_settings, power_display, cursor_now, companion_config, companion_report, companion_take, companion_said, ptt_take, ptt_sent, tts_ready, tts_synthesize, avatar_page, set_hit_rects) are not ACL-checked without an app manifest, and must be granted here if one is ever added; companion_config (the brain's token), companion_report, companion_take, companion_said, ptt_take and ptt_sent (push-to-talk's clip), tts_ready and tts_synthesize (his voice), avatar_page and set_hit_rects (where his body is on his window) must be granted to this window alone, and they check the calling window themselves.
